correctness.rationale: Minimizing the squared representer error over the weight gives exactly the Schur residual R_j, also for rank-deficient A. The unit-target supremum is outside the pivot expectation, so its value is the top eigenvalue of the mean residual. On range(A), write v_j=A^(1/2)e_j/sqrt(A_jj); the mean is A^(1/2)(I-D)A^(1/2) with D=sum_j p_j v_j v_j^T positive of trace one. In the positive eigenbasis, a bound z on the mean forces D_ii >= (1-z/lambda_i)_+. Their sum being at most one proves the water-filling floor t; the sum is continuous and strictly decreasing to zero up to the top eigenvalue, so t is unique. For each i!=j the trace-one budget gives t >= lambda_i lambda_j/(lambda_i+lambda_j), by adding the two necessary lower bounds on the diagonal budget (or optimizing just those two entries). The RP law has mean A-A^2/S; its i-th eigenvalue is the sum of lambda_i lambda_j/S over j!=i, at most (r-1)t, strictly less for r>2 and finite positive eigenvalues. At rank two the two positive mean-residual eigenvalues coincide with t irrespective of eigenvectors. For a diagonal kernel the simplex relaxation is exact; for diag(M,1,...,1), t=M(r-1)/(M(r-1)+1)<1, the large-coordinate RP risk is maximal for M>=1, and the ratio tends to r-1. No exact general formula for W_* at rank >=3 is asserted. Independent exact replay used a different rank-two Gram example (positive mean eigenvalues 9/7) and diagonal witnesses at ranks 2, 3, and 5; these are checks, not the proof. The frozen verifier's extra nondiagonal rank-three case checks the expectation identity, not the universal minimax inequality suggested by RESULT.md line 131; this is a nonessential overdescription of the test, not a gap in the theorem.
residual_risks: One pivot, positive diagonal, rank at least two; no multipivot, trace-loss, or target-adaptive sampling guarantee.

value.rationale: When the node is drawn before target weights are available, a standard and inexpensive pivot rule can be judged against the best implementable-in-principle target-independent distribution. Exact optimality for every rank-two eigenbasis and a sharp loss that grows with rank answer that natural robustness question; the diagonal witness isolates ill conditioning and supplies an explicit optimal replacement there. This is not just recomputing the known mean residual or changing the units of trace loss.
residual_risks: No evidence that the full sharp factor is typical of well-conditioned practical kernels; no quantitative claim of such typicality.
